about: Main-thread stacks of real Sentry "App Hanging" events, outermost frame first, each frame [inApp as Sentry marks it, index into images, symbol]. Symbols are the mangled names Sentry's server symbolicated; only addresses reach Sentry, and in-process dladdr gives the same names for most system frames on macOS 27. The server also expands Pacer's inlined frames from its dSYM: a release binary has PacerApp.$main inlined into main, one frame where these show two. Images are install paths for Apple's libraries, file names for anything else. Every PACER-M event (the entry point is the only Pacer frame), the three shortest with no Pacer frame at all, and one shorter event per issue with a Pacer frame.
